name: dumbbell supported squat v. 2
description: A dumbbell squat with a hand on a support for balance. Lets you focus on a deep, steady squat pattern.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest the other hand on a stable support.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up.
Switch the dumbbell hand halfway through if needed.
